LanguageData.Gun_MAT-49_9x19mm_RWP.label: MAT-49 9x19mm
LanguageData.Gun_MAT-49_9x19mm_RWP.description: The MAT-49 is a compact submachine gun chambered in 9x19mm. Developed for use by the French army, it offers a decent rate of fire and reliability in close to mid-range encounters. With its folding stock and simple blowback design, the MAT-49 excels in urban battles and tight spaces, providing a balance of accuracy, mobility, and stopping power.
